tools.name: list_my_fixtures
tools.description: List upcoming fixtures for teams the authenticated caller has joined
tools.sql: SELECT f.id,COALESCE(f.updated_at,f.created_at) AS updated_at,f.starts_at,f.time_status,f.arrival_at,f.round_label,f.status,f.status_updated_at,CASE WHEN (f.match_notice GLOB '*@*' OR f.match_notice GLOB '*[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]*') THEN NULL ELSE f.match_notice END AS match_notice,ht.name AS home_team_name,at.name AS away_team_name,CASE WHEN f.home_team_id IN (SELECT tp.team_id FROM team_players tp WHERE tp.user_id=:__user_id AND tp.is_active=1 UNION SELECT tm.team_id FROM team_memberships tm WHERE tm.user_id=:__user_id AND tm.accepted_at IS NOT NULL) THEN 'home' WHEN f.away_team_id IN (SELECT tp.team_id FROM team_players tp WHERE tp.user_id=:__user_id AND tp.is_active=1 UNION SELECT tm.team_id FROM team_memberships tm WHERE tm.user_id=:__user_id AND tm.accepted_at IS NOT NULL) THEN 'away' END AS member_side,CASE WHEN f.away_team_id IN (SELECT tp.team_id FROM team_players tp WHERE tp.user_id=:__user_id AND tp.is_active=1 UNION SELECT tm.team_id FROM team_memberships tm WHERE tm.user_id=:__user_id AND tm.accepted_at IS NOT NULL) AND f.home_team_id NOT IN (SELECT tp.team_id FROM team_players tp WHERE tp.user_id=:__user_id AND tp.is_active=1 UNION SELECT tm.team_id FROM team_memberships tm WHERE tm.user_id=:__user_id AND tm.accepted_at IS NOT NULL) THEN ht.name ELSE CASE WHEN at.is_external=1 THEN ec.canonical_name ELSE at.name END END AS opponent_name,CASE WHEN f.away_team_id IN (SELECT tp.team_id FROM team_players tp WHERE tp.user_id=:__user_id AND tp.is_active=1 UNION SELECT tm.team_id FROM team_memberships tm WHERE tm.user_id=:__user_id AND tm.accepted_at IS NOT NULL) AND f.home_team_id NOT IN (SELECT tp.team_id FROM team_players tp WHERE tp.user_id=:__user_id AND tp.is_active=1 UNION SELECT tm.team_id FROM team_memberships tm WHERE tm.user_id=:__user_id AND tm.accepted_at IS NOT NULL) THEN ht.is_external ELSE at.is_external END AS is_external_opponent,d.name AS division_name,v.name AS venue_name,v.address AS venue_address,v.map_url,CASE WHEN (v.notes GLOB '*@*' OR v.notes GLOB '*[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]*') THEN NULL ELSE v.notes END AS venue_notes,(SELECT fr.availability FROM fixture_roster fr WHERE fr.fixture_id=f.id AND fr.user_id=:__user_id) AS my_availability FROM fixtures f JOIN teams ht ON ht.id=f.home_team_id JOIN teams at ON at.id=f.away_team_id LEFT JOIN external_clubs ec ON ec.id=at.external_club_id LEFT JOIN divisions d ON d.id=f.division_id LEFT JOIN venues v ON v.id=f.venue_id WHERE f.starts_at>=:from AND ht.org_id=f.org_id AND at.org_id=f.org_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_players tp WHERE tp.user_id=:__user_id AND tp.is_active=1 AND tp.team_id IN(f.home_team_id,f.away_team_id)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_memberships tm WHERE tm.user_id=:__user_id AND tm.accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND tm.team_id IN(f.home_team_id,f.away_team_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams t WHERE t.id=tm.team_id AND t.org_id=f.org_id))) ORDER BY f.starts_at, f.id LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: list_fixture_roster
tools.description: List the selected fixture's player roster and availability when the caller belongs to either team
tools.sql: SELECT fr.user_id, fr.display_name, fr.availability, fr.selection, fr.pool, fr.confirmed_at, fr.confirmed_at AS updated_at FROM fixture_roster fr WHERE fr.fixture_id = :fixture_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fixtures f JOIN teams h ON h.id=f.home_team_id JOIN teams a ON a.id=f.away_team_id WHERE f.id=fr.fixture_id AND h.org_id=f.org_id AND a.org_id=f.org_id) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fixtures f JOIN team_players tp ON tp.team_id IN (f.home_team_id, f.away_team_id) WHERE f.id = :fixture_id AND tp.user_id = :__user_id AND tp.is_active = 1) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fixtures f JOIN team_memberships tm ON tm.team_id IN (f.home_team_id, f.away_team_id) WHERE f.id = :fixture_id AND tm.user_id = :__user_id AND tm.accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams t WHERE t.id=tm.team_id AND t.org_id=f.org_id))) ORDER BY CASE fr.availability WHEN 'in' THEN 0 WHEN 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, fr.display_name, fr.user_id LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: set_my_fixture_availability
tools.description: Set the caller's availability for a fixture they are rostered on
tools.sql: UPDATE fixture_roster SET availability = CASE WHEN :availability='not_sure' THEN 'pending' ELSE :availability END, confirmed_at = :__now WHERE fixture_id = :fixture_id AND user_id = :__user_id AND :availability IN ('in','out','pending','not_sure') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fixtures f WHERE f.id = :fixture_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams h JOIN teams a ON a.id=f.away_team_id WHERE h.id=f.home_team_id AND h.org_id=f.org_id AND a.org_id=f.org_id) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_players tp WHERE tp.user_id=:__user_id AND tp.is_active=1 AND tp.team_id IN(f.home_team_id,f.away_team_id)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_memberships tm WHERE tm.user_id=:__user_id AND tm.accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND tm.team_id IN(f.home_team_id,f.away_team_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams t WHERE t.id=tm.team_id AND t.org_id=f.org_id))))

tools.name: log_my_fixture_availability_change
tools.description: Record the signed-in player availability change after the roster update
tools.sql: INSERT INTO fixture_roster_activity(fixture_id,user_id,display_name,action,old_availability,new_availability,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT r.fixture_id,r.user_id,r.display_name,'availability_changed',:old_availability,r.availability,:__user_id,:__now FROM fixture_roster r JOIN fixtures f ON f.id=r.fixture_id WHERE r.fixture_id=:fixture_id AND r.user_id=:__user_id AND r.availability=:new_availability AND :old_availability IN ('in','out','pending') AND :new_availability IN ('in','out','pending') AND :old_availability<>:new_availability AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_players tp WHERE tp.user_id=:__user_id AND tp.is_active=1 AND tp.team_id IN(f.home_team_id,f.away_team_id)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_memberships tm JOIN teams t ON t.id=tm.team_id WHERE tm.user_id=:__user_id AND tm.accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND tm.team_id IN(f.home_team_id,f.away_team_id) AND t.org_id=f.org_id))

tools.name: list_fixture_import_options
tools.description: List internal teams, venues and external opponent clubs (placeholder team id, canonical name and normalised aliases) for clubs where the signed-in user is a manager, convenor or admin
tools.sql: SELECT 'team' AS kind, t.id, t.name, t.org_id, t.division_id, s.name AS season_name, NULL AS aliases FROM teams t LEFT JOIN divisions d ON d.id = t.division_id LEFT JOIN seasons s ON s.id = d.season_id WHERE t.is_external = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=t.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) UNION ALL SELECT 'venue' AS kind, v.id, v.name, v.org_id, NULL AS division_id, NULL AS season_name, NULL AS aliases FROM venues v WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=v.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) UNION ALL SELECT 'external_club' AS kind, t.id, ec.canonical_name, ec.org_id, NULL AS division_id, NULL AS season_name, (SELECT group_concat(a.normalized_alias, '|') FROM external_club_aliases a WHERE a.external_club_id = ec.id) AS aliases FROM external_clubs ec JOIN teams t ON t.external_club_id = ec.id AND t.is_external = 1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=ec.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) ORDER BY kind, name, id LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: upsert_imported_fixture
tools.description: Create or update an imported fixture; a row with no confirmed start time is stored as TBC and never as a confirmed time
tools.sql: INSERT INTO fixtures (id, org_id, division_id, home_team_id, away_team_id, venue_id, starts_at, round_label, status, created_at, time_status, arrival_at, source_row, source_date_raw, source_time_raw, source_import_run_id) SELECT :id, :org_id, (SELECT t.division_id FROM teams t WHERE t.id = :home_team_id AND t.org_id = :org_id), :home_team_id, :away_team_id, :venue_id, :starts_at, :round_label, 'scheduled', :__now, :time_status, :arrival_at, :source_row, :source_date_raw, :source_time_raw, :import_run_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=:org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams t JOIN divisions d ON d.id = t.division_id JOIN seasons s ON s.id = d.season_id WHERE t.id = :home_team_id AND t.org_id = :org_id AND t.is_external = 0 AND s.name = :season) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams t WHERE t.id = :away_team_id AND t.org_id = :org_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM venues v WHERE v.id = :venue_id AND v.org_id = :org_id) AND julianday(:starts_at) IS NOT NULL AND :time_status IN ('confirmed','estimated','tbc') AND (:warning_count = 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM import_issue_resolutions r WHERE r.org_id = :org_id AND r.import_run_id = :import_run_id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fixtures x WHERE x.org_id = :org_id AND x.round_label = :round_label AND x.home_team_id = :home_team_id AND x.away_team_id = :away_team_id AND x.starts_at <> :starts_at AND substr(x.starts_at,1,10) = substr(:starts_at,1,10)) ON CONFLICT(org_id, round_label, starts_at, home_team_id, away_team_id) DO UPDATE SET venue_id = excluded.venue_id, division_id = excluded.division_id, updated_at = :__now, time_status = excluded.time_status, arrival_at = COALESCE(excluded.arrival_at, fixtures.arrival_at), source_row = COALESCE(excluded.source_row, fixtures.source_row), source_date_raw = COALESCE(excluded.source_date_raw, fixtures.source_date_raw), source_time_raw = COALESCE(excluded.source_time_raw, fixtures.source_time_raw), source_import_run_id = COALESCE(excluded.source_import_run_id, fixtures.source_import_run_id) WHERE (CASE excluded.time_status WHEN 'confirmed' THEN 3 WHEN 'estimated' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) >= (CASE fixtures.time_status WHEN 'confirmed' THEN 3 WHEN 'estimated' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END)

tools.name: upsert_imported_roster_player
tools.description: Add an imported roster player by name; contact details are never accepted here, use set_contact_detail
tools.sql: INSERT INTO roster_players (id, fixture_id, player_name, availability, created_at) SELECT :id, f.id, :player_name, 'pending', :__now FROM fixtures f JOIN teams ht ON ht.id = f.home_team_id JOIN teams at ON at.id = f.away_team_id WHERE f.org_id = :org_id AND f.starts_at = :starts_at AND f.round_label = :round_label AND ((ht.name = :team AND at.name = :opponent) OR (at.name = :team AND ht.name = :opponent)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id = f.org_id AND cm.user_id = :__user_id AND cm.is_active = 1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) ON CONFLICT(fixture_id, player_name) DO NOTHING

tools.name: list_managed_clubs
tools.description: List clubs the caller administers
tools.sql: SELECT o.id, o.name, o.slug, cm.role, o.created_at AS updated_at FROM organizations o JOIN club_memberships cm ON cm.org_id=o.id WHERE cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager') ORDER BY o.name, o.id LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: can_create_first_club
tools.description: Check whether the signed-in user can create a first club or has an owned club awaiting administrator setup
tools.sql: SELECT 1 AS eligible, NULL AS pending_org_id, NULL AS pending_club_name WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.user_id=:__user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM organizations o WHERE o.created_by=:__user_id) UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS eligible, o.id AS pending_org_id, o.name AS pending_club_name FROM organizations o WHERE o.created_by=:__user_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.user_id=:__user_id) LIMIT 1

tools.name: create_club
tools.description: Create a first club for an authenticated user with no existing club memberships
tools.sql: INSERT INTO organizations (id,name,slug,created_at,created_by) SELECT :id,:name,:slug,:__now,:__user_id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.user_id=:__user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM organizations o WHERE o.created_by=:__user_id)

tools.name: bootstrap_club_admin
tools.description: Add the authenticated creator as administrator for their first club, or safely retry that setup
tools.sql: INSERT INTO club_memberships (id,org_id,user_id,role,display_name,is_active,created_at) SELECT :id,:org_id,:__user_id,'admin',:display_name,1,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM organizations o WHERE o.id=:org_id AND o.created_by=:__user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships other WHERE other.user_id=:__user_id AND other.org_id<>:org_id) ON CONFLICT(org_id,user_id) DO NOTHING

tools.name: list_club_seasons
tools.description: List club administration records for authorised managers
tools.sql: SELECT id,org_id,name,starts_on,ends_on,status,created_at AS updated_at FROM seasons WHERE org_id=:org_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id = :org_id AND cm.user_id = :__user_id AND cm.is_active = 1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) ORDER BY starts_on DESC, id LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: list_club_venues
tools.description: List venue records for managers; contact details are never part of a venue record and are listed with list_contact_details
tools.sql: SELECT id,org_id,name,address,map_url,notes,COALESCE(updated_at,created_at) AS updated_at FROM venues WHERE org_id=:org_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id = :org_id AND cm.user_id = :__user_id AND cm.is_active = 1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) ORDER BY name, id LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: list_club_teams
tools.description: List club administration records for authorised managers
tools.sql: SELECT t.id,t.org_id,t.name,t.colour,t.division_id,d.name AS division_name,s.name AS season_name,t.created_at AS updated_at FROM teams t LEFT JOIN divisions d ON d.id=t.division_id LEFT JOIN seasons s ON s.id=d.season_id WHERE t.org_id=:org_id AND t.is_external=0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id = :org_id AND cm.user_id = :__user_id AND cm.is_active = 1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) AND (:division_id IS NULL OR t.division_id=:division_id) ORDER BY t.name, t.id LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: list_club_divisions
tools.description: List club administration records for authorised managers
tools.sql: SELECT d.id,d.name,d.format,d.season_id,s.org_id,d.created_at AS updated_at FROM divisions d JOIN seasons s ON s.id=d.season_id WHERE s.org_id=:org_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id = :org_id AND cm.user_id = :__user_id AND cm.is_active = 1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) ORDER BY d.name, d.id LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: list_club_members
tools.description: List club administration records for authorised managers
tools.sql: SELECT cm.id,cm.user_id,cm.role,cm.display_name,cm.is_active,cm.created_at AS updated_at FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=:org_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id = :org_id AND cm.user_id = :__user_id AND cm.is_active = 1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) ORDER BY cm.display_name, cm.user_id LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: create_season
tools.description: Create a season in a club managed by the caller
tools.sql: INSERT INTO seasons (id,org_id,name,starts_on,ends_on,status,created_at) SELECT :id,:org_id,:name,:starts_on,:ends_on,:status,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id = :org_id AND cm.user_id = :__user_id AND cm.is_active = 1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) AND :starts_on <= :ends_on

tools.name: create_division
tools.description: Create a division in a managed club season
tools.sql: INSERT INTO divisions (id,season_id,name,format,created_at) SELECT :id,s.id,:name,:format,:__now FROM seasons s WHERE s.id=:season_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id = s.org_id AND cm.user_id = :__user_id AND cm.is_active = 1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager'))

tools.name: create_venue
tools.description: Create a venue in a club managed by the caller
tools.sql: INSERT INTO venues (id,org_id,name,address,map_url,notes,created_at) SELECT :id,:org_id,:name,:address,:map_url,:notes,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=:org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager'))

tools.name: create_team
tools.description: Create a team in a managed club; division must belong to that club
tools.sql: INSERT INTO teams (id,org_id,division_id,name,colour,created_at) SELECT :id,:org_id,:division_id,:name,:colour,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id = :org_id AND cm.user_id = :__user_id AND cm.is_active = 1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM divisions d JOIN seasons s ON s.id=d.season_id WHERE d.id=:division_id AND s.org_id=:org_id)

tools.name: create_team_invite
tools.description: Create a pending scoped team membership for a PAS invite
tools.sql: INSERT INTO team_memberships (id,org_id,team_id,invite_token,created_by,created_at) SELECT :id,t.org_id,t.id,:invite_token,:__user_id,:__now FROM teams t WHERE t.id=:team_id AND t.is_external=0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id = t.org_id AND cm.user_id = :__user_id AND cm.is_active = 1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager'))

tools.name: accept_team_invite
tools.description: Accept a team membership using its one-time token; the caller needs no PAS app role
tools.sql: UPDATE team_memberships SET user_id=:__user_id,display_name=:display_name,invite_token=NULL,accepted_at=:__now WHERE invite_token=:claim_token AND user_id IS NULL

tools.name: activate_invited_club_membership
tools.description: Create the club player membership for a pending team invite; existing club memberships keep their role and active state
tools.sql: INSERT INTO club_memberships (id,org_id,user_id,role,display_name,is_active,created_at) SELECT :id,tm.org_id,:__user_id,'player',:display_name,1,:__now FROM team_memberships tm WHERE tm.invite_token=:claim_token AND tm.user_id IS NULL ON CONFLICT(org_id,user_id) DO NOTHING

tools.name: get_my_club_permissions
tools.description: Return the caller role, active state and can_manage flag for one club; can_manage is true only for active admin, convenor or manager roles
tools.sql: SELECT cm.org_id,cm.role,cm.is_active,(cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) AS can_manage FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=:org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id

tools.name: list_managed_fixtures
tools.description: List fixtures managed by the caller with roster reply totals
tools.sql: SELECT f.id,f.org_id,COALESCE(f.updated_at,f.created_at) AS updated_at,f.starts_at,f.time_status,f.arrival_at,f.source_row,f.source_date_raw,f.source_time_raw,f.source_import_run_id,f.round_label,f.status,f.status_updated_at,f.match_notice,f.home_score,f.away_score,f.home_team_id,f.away_team_id,ht.name AS home_team_name,at.name AS away_team_name,CASE WHEN at.is_external=1 THEN ec.canonical_name ELSE at.name END AS opponent_name,at.is_external AS is_external_opponent,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fixture_roster r WHERE r.fixture_id=f.id AND r.availability='in') AS in_count,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fixture_roster r WHERE r.fixture_id=f.id AND r.availability='out') AS out_count,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fixture_roster r WHERE r.fixture_id=f.id AND r.availability='pending') AS pending_count FROM fixtures f JOIN teams ht ON ht.id=f.home_team_id JOIN teams at ON at.id=f.away_team_id LEFT JOIN external_clubs ec ON ec.id=at.external_club_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams home_owned WHERE home_owned.id=f.home_team_id AND home_owned.org_id=f.org_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams away_owned WHERE away_owned.id=f.away_team_id AND away_owned.org_id=f.org_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=f.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) AND (:status IS NULL OR f.status=:status) ORDER BY f.starts_at, f.id LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: list_managed_fixture_roster
tools.description: List roster and latest change time for a fixture managed by caller
tools.sql: SELECT r.user_id,r.display_name,r.availability,r.selection,r.pool,r.confirmed_at,COALESCE((SELECT MAX(a.created_at) FROM fixture_roster_activity a WHERE a.fixture_id=r.fixture_id AND a.user_id=r.user_id),r.confirmed_at) AS updated_at FROM fixture_roster r JOIN fixtures f ON f.id=r.fixture_id WHERE f.id=:fixture_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams h JOIN teams a ON a.id=f.away_team_id WHERE h.id=f.home_team_id AND h.org_id=f.org_id AND a.org_id=f.org_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=f.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) ORDER BY r.display_name, r.user_id LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: list_fixture_team_candidates
tools.description: List accepted members of either fixture team for roster publishing
tools.sql: SELECT DISTINCT tm.user_id,COALESCE(tp.display_name,tm.display_name,cm.display_name) AS display_name,COALESCE(tp.pool,'regular') AS pool FROM fixtures f JOIN team_memberships tm ON tm.team_id IN(f.home_team_id,f.away_team_id) LEFT JOIN team_players tp ON tp.team_id=tm.team_id AND tp.user_id=tm.user_id LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id=tm.team_id LEFT JOIN club_memberships cm ON cm.org_id=t.org_id AND cm.user_id=tm.user_id WHERE f.id=:fixture_id AND tm.user_id IS NOT NULL AND tm.accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND t.org_id=f.org_id AND COALESCE(tp.is_active,1)=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=f.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) ORDER BY pool, display_name, tm.user_id LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: add_fixture_roster_player
tools.description: Select a squad member for a fixture (or change their selection state): regular players may be selected, pending or unavailable; emergency players may only be called up
tools.sql: INSERT INTO fixture_roster(fixture_id,user_id,display_name,availability,selection,pool) SELECT f.id,tm.user_id,COALESCE(tp.display_name,tm.display_name,cm.display_name),'pending',:selection,COALESCE(tp.pool,'regular') FROM fixtures f JOIN team_memberships tm ON tm.user_id=:user_id AND tm.team_id IN(f.home_team_id,f.away_team_id) AND tm.accepted_at IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN team_players tp ON tp.team_id=tm.team_id AND tp.user_id=tm.user_id LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id=tm.team_id LEFT JOIN club_memberships cm ON cm.org_id=t.org_id AND cm.user_id=tm.user_id WHERE f.id=:fixture_id AND COALESCE(tp.is_active,1)=1 AND ((COALESCE(tp.pool,'regular')='regular' AND :selection IN ('selected','pending','unavailable')) OR (COALESCE(tp.pool,'regular')='emergency' AND :selection='emergency_call_up')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams h JOIN teams a ON a.id=f.away_team_id WHERE h.id=f.home_team_id AND h.org_id=f.org_id AND a.org_id=f.org_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams owned WHERE owned.id=tm.team_id AND owned.org_id=f.org_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=f.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) ON CONFLICT(fixture_id,user_id) DO UPDATE SET selection=excluded.selection, pool=excluded.pool

tools.name: log_fixture_roster_added
tools.description: Record a successfully published roster player after the roster insert
tools.sql: INSERT INTO fixture_roster_activity(fixture_id,user_id,display_name,action,new_availability,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT r.fixture_id,r.user_id,r.display_name,'added',r.availability,:__user_id,:__now FROM fixture_roster r JOIN fixtures f ON f.id=r.fixture_id WHERE r.fixture_id=:fixture_id AND r.user_id=:user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=f.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_memberships tm JOIN teams t ON t.id=tm.team_id WHERE tm.user_id=:user_id AND tm.accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND tm.team_id IN(f.home_team_id,f.away_team_id) AND t.org_id=f.org_id)

tools.name: remove_fixture_roster_player
tools.description: Remove a player from a fixture roster
tools.sql: DELETE FROM fixture_roster WHERE fixture_id=:fixture_id AND user_id=:user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fixtures f JOIN club_memberships cm ON cm.org_id=f.org_id WHERE f.id=:fixture_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams h JOIN teams a ON a.id=f.away_team_id WHERE h.id=f.home_team_id AND h.org_id=f.org_id AND a.org_id=f.org_id))

tools.name: log_fixture_roster_removed
tools.description: Record a removed roster player using the prior availability after the roster delete
tools.sql: INSERT INTO fixture_roster_activity(fixture_id,user_id,display_name,action,old_availability,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :fixture_id,:user_id,COALESCE((SELECT tm.display_name FROM team_memberships tm JOIN teams owned ON owned.id=tm.team_id WHERE tm.user_id=:user_id AND tm.accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND tm.team_id IN(f.home_team_id,f.away_team_id) AND owned.org_id=f.org_id ORDER BY tm.team_id LIMIT 1),(SELECT cm_player.display_name FROM club_memberships cm_player WHERE cm_player.org_id=f.org_id AND cm_player.user_id=:user_id)),'removed',:old_availability,:__user_id,:__now FROM fixtures f WHERE f.id=:fixture_id AND :old_availability IN ('in','out','pending') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fixture_roster r WHERE r.fixture_id=:fixture_id AND r.user_id=:user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_memberships tm JOIN teams owned ON owned.id=tm.team_id WHERE tm.user_id=:user_id AND tm.accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND tm.team_id IN(f.home_team_id,f.away_team_id) AND owned.org_id=f.org_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=f.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager'))

tools.name: list_fixture_roster_activity
tools.description: Read timestamped roster changes for a managed fixture
tools.sql: SELECT user_id,display_name,action,old_availability,new_availability,created_at FROM fixture_roster_activity a WHERE fixture_id=:fixture_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fixtures f JOIN club_memberships cm ON cm.org_id=f.org_id WHERE f.id=a.fixture_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams h JOIN teams a ON a.id=f.away_team_id WHERE h.id=f.home_team_id AND h.org_id=f.org_id AND a.org_id=f.org_id)) ORDER BY created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: update_venue
tools.description: Update a reusable venue and its travel details; only club managers may edit it
tools.sql: UPDATE venues SET name=:name,address=:address,map_url=:map_url,notes=:notes,updated_at=:__now WHERE id=:venue_id AND org_id=:org_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=venues.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager'))

tools.name: update_fixture_match_day
tools.description: Set a fixture match-day status and concise notice as an active club manager, convenor or administrator
tools.sql: UPDATE fixtures SET status=:status, status_updated_at=:__now, match_notice=NULLIF(trim(:match_notice),''),updated_at=:__now WHERE id=:fixture_id AND :status IN ('scheduled','washout','heat_out','forfeit','complete') AND length(trim(:match_notice))<=280 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams h JOIN teams a ON a.id=fixtures.away_team_id WHERE h.id=fixtures.home_team_id AND h.org_id=fixtures.org_id AND a.org_id=fixtures.org_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=fixtures.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager'))

tools.name: submit_fixture_result
tools.description: Submit or correct a fixture result as an active club manager; each submission is retained as history
tools.sql: INSERT INTO fixture_result_submissions(id,fixture_id,submitted_by,home_score,away_score,set_results,scorecard_user_id,scorecard_path,submitted_at,correction_note) SELECT :id,f.id,:__user_id,:home_score,:away_score,:set_results,:scorecard_user_id,:scorecard_path,:__now,NULLIF(trim(:correction_note),'') FROM fixtures f WHERE f.id=:fixture_id AND :home_score>=0 AND :away_score>=0 AND length(:set_results)<=4000 AND length(trim(:correction_note))<=500 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=f.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams h JOIN teams a ON a.id=f.away_team_id WHERE h.id=f.home_team_id AND h.org_id=f.org_id AND a.org_id=f.org_id)

set_results.description: Optional JSON array of set scores

tools.name: apply_fixture_result_to_fixture
tools.description: Apply a newly inserted result submission to its fixture scores and status
tools.sql: UPDATE fixtures SET home_score=(SELECT s.home_score FROM fixture_result_submissions s WHERE s.id=:submission_id AND s.fixture_id=:fixture_id),away_score=(SELECT s.away_score FROM fixture_result_submissions s WHERE s.id=:submission_id AND s.fixture_id=:fixture_id),status='complete',status_updated_at=(SELECT s.submitted_at FROM fixture_result_submissions s WHERE s.id=:submission_id AND s.fixture_id=:fixture_id),updated_at=:__now WHERE id=:fixture_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fixture_result_submissions s WHERE s.id=:submission_id AND s.fixture_id=fixtures.id AND s.submitted_by=:__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=fixtures.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager'))

tools.name: list_managed_fixture_results
tools.description: List result status and submission history for fixtures in clubs managed by caller, including missing or late scorecards
tools.sql: SELECT f.id AS fixture_id,COALESCE(f.updated_at,f.created_at) AS updated_at,f.starts_at,f.round_label,f.status,f.home_score,f.away_score,latest.submitted_at,latest.scorecard_user_id,latest.scorecard_path,latest.correction_note,CASE WHEN latest.id IS NULL AND f.status='complete' AND CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 > CAST(strftime('%s',date(f.starts_at,'weekday 2','+12 hours')) AS INTEGER)*1000 THEN 'late' WHEN latest.id IS NULL THEN 'missing' WHEN latest.scorecard_path IS NULL THEN 'incomplete' WHEN latest.submitted_at > CAST(strftime('%s',date(f.starts_at,'weekday 2','+12 hours')) AS INTEGER)*1000 THEN 'late' ELSE 'submitted' END AS card_state,ht.name AS home_team_name,at.name AS away_team_name FROM fixtures f JOIN teams ht ON ht.id=f.home_team_id JOIN teams at ON at.id=f.away_team_id LEFT JOIN fixture_result_submissions latest ON latest.id=(SELECT s.id FROM fixture_result_submissions s WHERE s.fixture_id=f.id ORDER BY s.submitted_at DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams h JOIN teams a ON a.id=f.away_team_id WHERE h.id=f.home_team_id AND h.org_id=f.org_id AND a.org_id=f.org_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=f.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) ORDER BY f.starts_at DESC, f.id LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: list_fixture_result_history
tools.description: Read prior result submissions for a fixture managed by caller
tools.sql: SELECT s.id,s.home_score,s.away_score,s.set_results,s.scorecard_user_id,s.scorecard_path,s.submitted_at,s.correction_note,s.submitted_by,s.submitted_at AS updated_at FROM fixture_result_submissions s JOIN fixtures f ON f.id=s.fixture_id WHERE f.id=:fixture_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams h JOIN teams a ON a.id=f.away_team_id WHERE h.id=f.home_team_id AND h.org_id=f.org_id AND a.org_id=f.org_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=f.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) ORDER BY s.submitted_at DESC, s.id LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: get_club
tools.description: Read one club the caller actively belongs to (any club role)
tools.sql: SELECT o.id,o.name,o.slug,o.created_at AS updated_at FROM organizations o WHERE o.id=:org_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=o.id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1)

tools.name: list_import_reports
tools.description: List fixture and roster import runs recorded for a club, newest first
tools.sql: SELECT r.id,r.org_id,r.kind,r.actor_user_id,r.received_count,r.saved_count,r.rejected_count,r.status,r.source_sha256,r.blocking_count,r.warning_count,r.acknowledged_count,r.created_at,r.created_at AS updated_at FROM import_runs r WHERE r.org_id=:org_id AND (:kind IS NULL OR r.kind=:kind) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=r.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: record_import_run
tools.description: Record the outcome of a fixture or roster import in the club's import report
tools.sql: INSERT INTO import_runs (id,org_id,actor_user_id,kind,received_count,saved_count,rejected_count,status,created_at,source_sha256,blocking_count,warning_count,acknowledged_count) SELECT :id,:org_id,:__user_id,:kind,:received_count,:saved_count,:rejected_count,:status,:__now,:source_sha256,:blocking_count,:warning_count,:acknowledged_count WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=:org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager'))

tools.name: list_audit_events
tools.description: List audit events for a club (actor, action, target, outcome), newest first
tools.sql: SELECT e.id,e.org_id,e.actor_user_id,e.action,e.target_type,e.target_id,e.outcome,e.created_at FROM audit_events e WHERE e.org_id=:org_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=e.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: record_audit_event
tools.description: Record a managed write (succeeded or refused) in the club audit trail; the actor is the authenticated caller
tools.sql: INSERT INTO audit_events (id,org_id,actor_user_id,action,target_type,target_id,outcome,created_at) SELECT :id,:org_id,:__user_id,:action,:target_type,:target_id,:outcome,:__now WHERE :action IN ('add_external_club_alias', 'add_fixture_roster_player', 'apply_draw_divisions', 'apply_draw_external_aliases', 'apply_draw_external_clubs', 'apply_draw_fixture_updates', 'apply_draw_fixtures', 'apply_draw_placeholders', 'apply_draw_provenance', 'apply_draw_roster', 'apply_draw_seasons', 'apply_draw_teams', 'apply_draw_venue_updates', 'apply_draw_venues', 'apply_fixture_result_to_fixture', 'bootstrap_club_admin', 'create_division', 'create_external_club', 'create_external_club_placeholder', 'create_season', 'create_team', 'create_team_invite', 'create_venue', 'deactivate_team_player', 'delete_contact_detail', 'reconcile_imported_fixture_time', 'remove_fixture_roster_player', 'schedule_fixture', 'set_contact_detail', 'set_external_club_home_venue', 'set_team_player_pool', 'submit_fixture_result', 'update_fixture_match_day', 'update_venue', 'upsert_imported_fixture', 'upsert_imported_roster_player') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=:org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager'))

tools.name: list_authorised_documents
tools.description: List submitted scorecard metadata for a club's fixtures; storage keys and submitter identities are withheld
tools.sql: SELECT s.id AS document_id,s.fixture_id,s.home_score,s.away_score,s.submitted_at,s.submitted_at AS updated_at,CASE WHEN s.scorecard_path IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_document FROM fixture_result_submissions s JOIN fixtures f ON f.id=s.fixture_id WHERE f.org_id=:org_id AND (:fixture_id IS NULL OR s.fixture_id=:fixture_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams h JOIN teams a ON a.id=f.away_team_id WHERE h.id=f.home_team_id AND h.org_id=f.org_id AND a.org_id=f.org_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=f.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) ORDER BY s.submitted_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: create_external_club
tools.description: Create an external opponent club owned by this club; the canonical name is trimmed and normalised for matching
tools.sql: INSERT INTO external_clubs (id,org_id,canonical_name,normalized_name,created_at,updated_at) SELECT :id,:org_id,trim(:canonical_name),trim(replace(replace(replace(lower(:canonical_name),'  ',' '),'  ',' '),'  ',' ')),:__now,:__now WHERE length(trim(replace(replace(replace(lower(:canonical_name),'  ',' '),'  ',' '),'  ',' ')))>0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=:org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager'))

tools.name: create_external_club_placeholder
tools.description: Create the internal placeholder team that stands for an external club in fixtures; at most one per external club
tools.sql: INSERT INTO teams (id,org_id,division_id,name,colour,created_at,external_club_id,is_external) SELECT :id,ec.org_id,NULL,ec.canonical_name,NULL,:__now,ec.id,1 FROM external_clubs ec WHERE ec.id=:external_club_id AND ec.org_id=:org_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=:org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) ON CONFLICT(org_id,external_club_id) WHERE external_club_id IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING

tools.name: add_external_club_alias
tools.description: Add an alias that import matching may use for an external club; aliases are unique within a club and cannot repeat another external club's canonical name there
tools.sql: INSERT INTO external_club_aliases (id,org_id,external_club_id,alias,normalized_alias,created_at) SELECT :id,ec.org_id,ec.id,trim(:alias),trim(replace(replace(replace(lower(:alias),'  ',' '),'  ',' '),'  ',' ')),:__now FROM external_clubs ec WHERE ec.id=:external_club_id AND ec.org_id=:org_id AND length(trim(replace(replace(replace(lower(:alias),'  ',' '),'  ',' '),'  ',' ')))>0 AND instr(:alias,'|')=0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM external_clubs x WHERE x.org_id=ec.org_id AND x.normalized_name=trim(replace(replace(replace(lower(:alias),'  ',' '),'  ',' '),'  ',' '))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=:org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager'))

tools.name: set_external_club_home_venue
tools.description: Set the home venue of an external club to a venue owned by this club
tools.sql: UPDATE external_clubs SET home_venue_id=:venue_id,updated_at=:__now WHERE id=:external_club_id AND org_id=:org_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM venues v WHERE v.id=:venue_id AND v.org_id=:org_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=:org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager'))

tools.name: list_external_clubs
tools.description: List external opponent clubs for a club with their aliases and home venue name; any active club member may read
tools.sql: SELECT ec.id,ec.org_id,ec.canonical_name,ec.normalized_name,ec.home_venue_id,v.name AS home_venue_name,(SELECT group_concat(a.alias,'|') FROM external_club_aliases a WHERE a.external_club_id=ec.id) AS aliases,ec.created_at,COALESCE(ec.updated_at,ec.created_at) AS updated_at FROM external_clubs ec LEFT JOIN venues v ON v.id=ec.home_venue_id WHERE ec.org_id=:org_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=ec.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1) ORDER BY ec.canonical_name, ec.id LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: schedule_fixture
tools.description: Schedule a fixture between an internal home team and an internal or external away team of the same club
tools.sql: INSERT INTO fixtures (id,org_id,division_id,home_team_id,away_team_id,venue_id,starts_at,round_label,status,created_at) SELECT :id,:org_id,:division_id,:home_team_id,:away_team_id,:venue_id,:starts_at,:round_label,'scheduled',:__now WHERE :home_team_id<>:away_team_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams t WHERE t.id=:home_team_id AND t.org_id=:org_id AND t.is_external=0) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams t WHERE t.id=:away_team_id AND t.org_id=:org_id) AND (:venue_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM venues v WHERE v.id=:venue_id AND v.org_id=:org_id)) AND (:division_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM divisions d JOIN seasons s ON s.id=d.season_id WHERE d.id=:division_id AND s.org_id=:org_id)) AND julianday(:starts_at) IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=:org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager'))

tools.name: set_team_player_pool
tools.description: Place an accepted team member in the regular or emergency pool of a team's squad and make them active
tools.sql: INSERT INTO team_players (team_id,user_id,display_name,is_active,pool,updated_at,updated_by) SELECT tm.team_id,tm.user_id,COALESCE(tm.display_name,'Player'),1,:pool,:__now,:__user_id FROM team_memberships tm JOIN teams t ON t.id=tm.team_id WHERE tm.team_id=:team_id AND t.org_id=:org_id AND t.is_external=0 AND tm.user_id=:user_id AND tm.accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND :pool IN ('regular','emergency') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=:org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) ON CONFLICT(team_id,user_id) DO UPDATE SET pool=excluded.pool, is_active=1, updated_at=excluded.updated_at, updated_by=excluded.updated_by

tools.name: deactivate_team_player
tools.description: Take an accepted team member out of the active squad so they can no longer be selected; team membership and fixture visibility are unchanged
tools.sql: INSERT INTO team_players (team_id,user_id,display_name,is_active,pool,updated_at,updated_by) SELECT tm.team_id,tm.user_id,COALESCE(tm.display_name,'Player'),0,'regular',:__now,:__user_id FROM team_memberships tm JOIN teams t ON t.id=tm.team_id WHERE tm.team_id=:team_id AND t.org_id=:org_id AND tm.user_id=:user_id AND tm.accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=:org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) ON CONFLICT(team_id,user_id) DO UPDATE SET is_active=0, updated_at=excluded.updated_at, updated_by=excluded.updated_by

tools.name: log_team_pool_change
tools.description: Append a pool or squad change to the team's history with its actor
tools.sql: INSERT INTO team_pool_history (id,org_id,team_id,user_id,display_name,action,old_pool,new_pool,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :id,t.org_id,t.id,:user_id,:display_name,:action,:old_pool,:new_pool,:__user_id,:__now FROM teams t WHERE t.id=:team_id AND t.org_id=:org_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=:org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager'))

tools.name: log_fixture_selection_change
tools.description: Append a roster selection change to the fixture's history with its actor; call after setting a selection state
tools.sql: INSERT INTO fixture_selection_history (id,org_id,fixture_id,user_id,display_name,pool,old_selection,new_selection,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :id,f.org_id,r.fixture_id,r.user_id,r.display_name,r.pool,:old_selection,r.selection,:__user_id,:__now FROM fixture_roster r JOIN fixtures f ON f.id=r.fixture_id WHERE r.fixture_id=:fixture_id AND r.user_id=:user_id AND f.org_id=:org_id AND (:old_selection IS NULL OR :old_selection<>r.selection) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=f.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager'))

tools.name: list_team_pool
tools.description: List a team's squad with each player's pool (regular or emergency) and active state; managers see the whole squad, members see only their own row
tools.sql: SELECT tm.team_id,tm.user_id,COALESCE(tp.display_name,tm.display_name) AS display_name,COALESCE(tp.pool,'regular') AS pool,COALESCE(tp.is_active,1) AS is_active,COALESCE(tp.updated_at,tm.accepted_at) AS updated_at FROM team_memberships tm JOIN teams t ON t.id=tm.team_id LEFT JOIN team_players tp ON tp.team_id=tm.team_id AND tp.user_id=tm.user_id WHERE tm.team_id=:team_id AND t.org_id=:org_id AND tm.user_id IS NOT NULL AND tm.accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=:org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) OR tm.user_id=:__user_id) ORDER BY COALESCE(tp.pool,'regular'), display_name, tm.user_id LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: list_team_pool_history
tools.description: List pool and squad changes for a team with the actor who made each change, newest first
tools.sql: SELECT h.id,h.user_id,h.display_name,h.action,h.old_pool,h.new_pool,h.actor_user_id,h.created_at FROM team_pool_history h WHERE h.org_id=:org_id AND h.team_id=:team_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=h.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) ORDER BY h.created_at DESC, h.id DESC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: list_fixture_selection_history
tools.description: List selection state changes for a fixture with the actor who made each change, newest first
tools.sql: SELECT h.id,h.user_id,h.display_name,h.pool,h.old_selection,h.new_selection,h.actor_user_id,h.created_at FROM fixture_selection_history h WHERE h.org_id=:org_id AND h.fixture_id=:fixture_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=h.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) ORDER BY h.created_at DESC, h.id DESC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: validate_fixture_import
tools.description: Dry-run a fixture import: returns every blocking conflict and warning for the source rows (JSON array of raw CSV rows), without writing anything
tools.sql: SELECT v.source_row,v.severity,v.code,v.field,v.message,v.remediation FROM (WITH src AS (SELECT CAST(json_extract(j.value,'$.source_row') AS INTEGER) AS n, trim(COALESCE(json_extract(j.value,'$.date'),'')) AS date_raw, trim(COALESCE(json_extract(j.value,'$.start_time'),'')) AS start_raw, trim(COALESCE(json_extract(j.value,'$.arrival_time'),'')) AS arrival_raw, lower(trim(COALESCE(json_extract(j.value,'$.time_status'),''))) AS status_raw, trim(COALESCE(json_extract(j.value,'$.timezone'),'')) AS tz_raw, trim(COALESCE(json_extract(j.value,'$.round'),'')) AS round_raw, trim(COALESCE(json_extract(j.value,'$.team'),'')) AS team_raw, trim(COALESCE(json_extract(j.value,'$.opponent'),'')) AS opp_raw, lower(trim(COALESCE(json_extract(j.value,'$.home_away'),''))) AS side_raw, trim(COALESCE(json_extract(j.value,'$.venue'),'')) AS venue_raw, trim(COALESCE(json_extract(j.value,'$.season'),'')) AS season_raw FROM json_each(:rows) j), s AS (SELECT src.*, CASE WHEN date_raw GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date(date_raw)=date_raw THEN date_raw WHEN date_raw GLOB '[0-9][0-9]/[0-9][0-9]/[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' AND date(substr(date_raw,7,4)||'-'||substr(date_raw,4,2)||'-'||substr(date_raw,1,2))=(substr(date_raw,7,4)||'-'||substr(date_raw,4,2)||'-'||substr(date_raw,1,2)) THEN substr(date_raw,7,4)||'-'||substr(date_raw,4,2)||'-'||substr(date_raw,1,2) END AS iso, CASE WHEN date_raw GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-*' THEN 'iso' WHEN date_raw GLOB '[0-9][0-9]/*' THEN 'dmy' ELSE 'other' END AS fmt, CASE WHEN start_raw GLOB '[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]' AND substr(start_raw,1,2)<'24' THEN start_raw END AS start_hm, CASE WHEN arrival_raw GLOB '[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]' AND substr(arrival_raw,1,2)<'24' THEN arrival_raw END AS arrival_hm, CASE WHEN status_raw<>'' THEN status_raw WHEN start_raw<>'' THEN 'confirmed' ELSE 'tbc' END AS eff_status, CASE (CASE WHEN status_raw<>'' THEN status_raw WHEN start_raw<>'' THEN 'confirmed' ELSE 'tbc' END) WHEN 'confirmed' THEN 3 WHEN 'estimated' THEN 2 WHEN 'tbc' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rank_in, lower(team_raw) AS team_l, lower(venue_raw) AS venue_l, trim(replace(replace(replace(lower(opp_raw),'  ',' '),'  ',' '),'  ',' ')) AS opp_n FROM src), m AS (SELECT s.n AS n, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teams t WHERE t.org_id=:org_id AND t.is_external=0 AND lower(trim(t.name))=s.team_l) AS team_matches, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teams t WHERE t.org_id=:org_id AND t.is_external=0 AND lower(trim(t.name))=s.opp_n) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT ec.id FROM external_clubs ec WHERE ec.org_id=:org_id AND ec.normalized_name=s.opp_n UNION SELECT a.external_club_id FROM external_club_aliases a WHERE a.org_id=:org_id AND a.normalized_alias=s.opp_n)) AS opp_matches, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM venues v WHERE v.org_id=:org_id AND lower(trim(v.name))=s.venue_l) AS venue_matches FROM s), e AS (SELECT f.round_label AS round_label, f.starts_at AS starts_at, f.time_status AS time_status, lower(trim(ht.name)) AS home_l, lower(trim(at.name)) AS away_l FROM fixtures f JOIN teams ht ON ht.id=f.home_team_id JOIN teams at ON at.id=f.away_team_id WHERE f.org_id=:org_id) SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'blocking' AS severity, 'invalid_date' AS code, 'date' AS field, 'Date is not a real yyyy-mm-dd or dd/mm/yyyy calendar date' AS message, 'Use yyyy-mm-dd or dd/mm/yyyy with a real date' AS remediation FROM s WHERE s.iso IS NULL UNION SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'warning' AS severity, 'mixed_date_format' AS code, 'date' AS field, 'This source mixes date formats' AS message, 'Check each date, then accept the warning' AS remediation FROM s WHERE s.fmt IN ('iso','dmy') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s t WHERE t.fmt IN ('iso','dmy') AND t.fmt<>s.fmt) UNION SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'blocking' AS severity, 'invalid_time' AS code, 'start_time' AS field, 'Start time must be a 24-hour time written as four digits, for example 1430' AS message, 'Enter four digits such as 1430 or leave the start time blank' AS remediation FROM s WHERE s.start_raw<>'' AND s.start_hm IS NULL UNION SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'blocking' AS severity, 'invalid_arrival_time' AS code, 'arrival_time' AS field, 'Arrival time must be a 24-hour time written as four digits, for example 0830' AS message, 'Enter four digits such as 0830 or leave the arrival time blank' AS remediation FROM s WHERE s.arrival_raw<>'' AND s.arrival_hm IS NULL UNION SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'blocking' AS severity, 'invalid_time_status' AS code, 'time_status' AS field, 'Time status must be confirmed, estimated or tbc' AS message, 'Use confirmed, estimated or tbc, or leave it blank' AS remediation FROM s WHERE s.status_raw NOT IN ('','confirmed','estimated','tbc') UNION SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'blocking' AS severity, 'confirmed_without_start' AS code, 'time_status' AS field, 'Start time is marked confirmed but no start time is given' AS message, 'Give the start time or mark it tbc' AS remediation FROM s WHERE s.status_raw='confirmed' AND s.start_raw='' UNION SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'warning' AS severity, 'start_time_missing' AS code, 'start_time' AS field, 'No start time in the source, it will be stored as TBC, not as a confirmed time' AS message, 'Accept as TBC, or add the confirmed start time' AS remediation FROM s WHERE s.start_raw='' UNION SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'warning' AS severity, 'arrival_without_start' AS code, 'arrival_time' AS field, 'Arrival time given without a confirmed start time' AS message, 'Confirm the start time before publishing, arrival is stored separately' AS remediation FROM s WHERE s.arrival_raw<>'' AND s.start_raw='' UNION SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'warning' AS severity, 'estimated_time' AS code, 'time_status' AS field, 'Start time is marked estimated in the source' AS message, 'Accept only if the estimate is acceptable' AS remediation FROM s WHERE s.status_raw='estimated' UNION SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'blocking' AS severity, 'timezone_mismatch' AS code, 'timezone' AS field, 'Source timezone is not Australia/Melbourne' AS message, 'Correct the timezone or convert the times before importing' AS remediation FROM s WHERE s.tz_raw<>'' AND s.tz_raw<>'Australia/Melbourne' UNION SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'blocking' AS severity, 'missing_round' AS code, 'round' AS field, 'Round is required to identify the fixture' AS message, 'Enter the round' AS remediation FROM s WHERE s.round_raw='' UNION SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'blocking' AS severity, 'invalid_home_away' AS code, 'home_away' AS field, 'home_away must be home or away' AS message, 'Use home or away' AS remediation FROM s WHERE s.side_raw NOT IN ('home','away') UNION SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'blocking' AS severity, 'missing_team' AS code, 'team' AS field, 'Team is required' AS message, 'Enter the team name' AS remediation FROM s WHERE s.team_raw='' UNION SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'blocking' AS severity, 'team_not_found' AS code, 'team' AS field, 'Team does not match a team in this club' AS message, 'Correct the team name or add the team first' AS remediation FROM s JOIN m ON m.n=s.n WHERE s.team_raw<>'' AND m.team_matches=0 UNION SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'blocking' AS severity, 'team_ambiguous' AS code, 'team' AS field, 'Team name matches more than one team in this club' AS message, 'Rename one of the teams' AS remediation FROM s JOIN m ON m.n=s.n WHERE m.team_matches>1 UNION SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'blocking' AS severity, 'missing_opponent' AS code, 'opponent' AS field, 'Opponent is required' AS message, 'Enter the opponent name' AS remediation FROM s WHERE s.opp_raw='' UNION SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'blocking' AS severity, 'opponent_not_found' AS code, 'opponent' AS field, 'Opponent matches no team or external club or alias in this club' AS message, 'Add the external club or alias, or correct the name' AS remediation FROM s JOIN m ON m.n=s.n WHERE s.opp_raw<>'' AND m.opp_matches=0 UNION SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'blocking' AS severity, 'opponent_ambiguous' AS code, 'opponent' AS field, 'Opponent name matches more than one club or alias' AS message, 'Resolve the duplicate alias' AS remediation FROM s JOIN m ON m.n=s.n WHERE m.opp_matches>1 UNION SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'blocking' AS severity, 'missing_venue' AS code, 'venue' AS field, 'Venue is required' AS message, 'Enter the venue name' AS remediation FROM s WHERE s.venue_raw='' UNION SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'blocking' AS severity, 'venue_not_found' AS code, 'venue' AS field, 'Venue does not match a venue in this club' AS message, 'Add the venue or correct its name' AS remediation FROM s JOIN m ON m.n=s.n WHERE s.venue_raw<>'' AND m.venue_matches=0 UNION SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'blocking' AS severity, 'venue_ambiguous' AS code, 'venue' AS field, 'Venue name matches more than one venue in this club' AS message, 'Rename one of the venues' AS remediation FROM s JOIN m ON m.n=s.n WHERE m.venue_matches>1 UNION SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'blocking' AS severity, 'missing_season' AS code, 'season' AS field, 'Season is required' AS message, 'Enter the season name' AS remediation FROM s WHERE s.season_raw='' UNION SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'blocking' AS severity, 'season_mismatch' AS code, 'season' AS field, 'Team is not assigned to this season' AS message, 'Check the season or the team division' AS remediation FROM s JOIN m ON m.n=s.n WHERE s.season_raw<>'' AND m.team_matches=1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams t JOIN divisions d ON d.id=t.division_id JOIN seasons se ON se.id=d.season_id WHERE t.org_id=:org_id AND t.is_external=0 AND lower(trim(t.name))=s.team_l AND lower(trim(se.name))=lower(s.season_raw)) UNION SELECT a.n AS source_row, 'blocking' AS severity, 'conflicting_date' AS code, 'date' AS field, 'Rows for the same fixture give different dates' AS message, 'Correct the source so every row agrees, then re-check' AS remediation FROM s a JOIN s b ON b.team_l=a.team_l AND b.opp_n=a.opp_n AND b.round_raw=a.round_raw AND b.n<>a.n WHERE COALESCE(b.iso,'')<>COALESCE(a.iso,'') UNION SELECT a.n AS source_row, 'blocking' AS severity, 'conflicting_home_away' AS code, 'home_away' AS field, 'Rows for the same fixture disagree on home or away' AS message, 'Correct the source so every row agrees' AS remediation FROM s a JOIN s b ON b.team_l=a.team_l AND b.opp_n=a.opp_n AND b.round_raw=a.round_raw AND b.n<>a.n WHERE b.side_raw<>a.side_raw UNION SELECT a.n AS source_row, 'blocking' AS severity, 'conflicting_venue' AS code, 'venue' AS field, 'Rows for the same fixture name different venues' AS message, 'Correct the source so every row agrees' AS remediation FROM s a JOIN s b ON b.team_l=a.team_l AND b.opp_n=a.opp_n AND b.round_raw=a.round_raw AND b.n<>a.n WHERE b.venue_l<>a.venue_l UNION SELECT a.n AS source_row, 'blocking' AS severity, 'conflicting_start_time' AS code, 'start_time' AS field, 'Rows for the same fixture disagree on the start time' AS message, 'Correct the source so every row agrees' AS remediation FROM s a JOIN s b ON b.team_l=a.team_l AND b.opp_n=a.opp_n AND b.round_raw=a.round_raw AND b.n<>a.n WHERE COALESCE(b.start_hm,'')<>COALESCE(a.start_hm,'') UNION SELECT a.n AS source_row, 'warning' AS severity, 'duplicate_row' AS code, 'round' AS field, 'This row repeats an earlier row in the source' AS message, 'Remove the duplicate or accept the warning' AS remediation FROM s a WHERE a.iso IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s b WHERE b.n<a.n AND b.team_l=a.team_l AND b.opp_n=a.opp_n AND b.round_raw=a.round_raw AND COALESCE(b.iso,'')=COALESCE(a.iso,'') AND b.venue_l=a.venue_l AND b.side_raw=a.side_raw AND COALESCE(b.start_hm,'')=COALESCE(a.start_hm,'')) UNION SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'warning' AS severity, 'time_downgrade' AS code, 'time_status' AS field, 'This source gives a less certain time than the stored fixture' AS message, 'Keep the stored time, or accept to record the weaker source' AS remediation FROM s JOIN e ON e.round_label=s.round_raw AND substr(e.starts_at,1,10)=s.iso AND ((s.side_raw='home' AND e.home_l=s.team_l AND e.away_l=s.opp_n) OR (s.side_raw='away' AND e.away_l=s.team_l AND e.home_l=s.opp_n)) WHERE s.rank_in < (CASE e.time_status WHEN 'confirmed' THEN 3 WHEN 'estimated' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) UNION SELECT s.n AS source_row, 'warning' AS severity, 'time_change' AS code, 'start_time' AS field, 'This source confirms a different start time from the stored fixture' AS message, 'Accept to replace the stored time, or correct the source' AS remediation FROM s JOIN e ON e.round_label=s.round_raw AND substr(e.starts_at,1,10)=s.iso AND ((s.side_raw='home' AND e.home_l=s.team_l AND e.away_l=s.opp_n) OR (s.side_raw='away' AND e.away_l=s.team_l AND e.home_l=s.opp_n)) WHERE s.eff_status='confirmed' AND e.time_status='confirmed' AND substr(e.starts_at,12,5)<>s.start_hm) v WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=:org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) ORDER BY v.source_row, v.code

tools.name: reconcile_imported_fixture_time
tools.description: Apply a later source's start time to the same fixture on the same date, only when the new time status is at least as confident as the stored one
tools.sql: UPDATE fixtures SET starts_at = :starts_at, time_status = :time_status, arrival_at = COALESCE(:arrival_at, arrival_at), source_row = :source_row, source_date_raw = :source_date_raw, source_time_raw = :source_time_raw, source_import_run_id = :import_run_id, updated_at = :__now WHERE org_id = :org_id AND round_label = :round_label AND home_team_id = :home_team_id AND away_team_id = :away_team_id AND substr(starts_at,1,10) = substr(:starts_at,1,10) AND starts_at <> :starts_at AND :time_status IN ('confirmed','estimated','tbc') AND (CASE :time_status WHEN 'confirmed' THEN 3 WHEN 'estimated' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) >= (CASE time_status WHEN 'confirmed' THEN 3 WHEN 'estimated' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=fixtures.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager'))

tools.name: record_fixture_import_resolution
tools.description: Record that a manager accepted a warning for one source row of an import run; blocking conflicts cannot be recorded
tools.sql: INSERT INTO import_issue_resolutions (id,org_id,import_run_id,code,source_row,resolution,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :id,:org_id,:import_run_id,:code,:source_row,'accepted',:__user_id,:__now WHERE :code IN ('mixed_date_format', 'start_time_missing', 'arrival_without_start', 'estimated_time', 'duplicate_row', 'time_downgrade', 'time_change') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=:org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) ON CONFLICT(import_run_id,code,source_row) DO NOTHING

tools.name: get_draw_import_report
tools.description: Structured report of one competition-draw import run: record counts by outcome (create, adopt, unchanged, update, conflict, error, skipped, failed)
tools.sql: SELECT o.action, o.severity, COUNT(*) AS records FROM draw_import_records o JOIN draw_import_runs r ON r.id=o.run_id WHERE o.run_id=:import_run_id AND o.org_id=:org_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=o.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin')) GROUP BY o.action, o.severity ORDER BY o.action

tools.name: set_contact_detail
tools.description: Save a structured contact detail for a team, venue, club or person; visible only to club managers, convenors and admins
tools.sql: INSERT INTO contact_details (id,org_id,subject_type,subject_id,label,kind,value,created_by,created_at,updated_at) SELECT :id,:org_id,:subject_type,:subject_id,trim(:label),:kind,trim(:value),:__user_id,:__now,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=:org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) AND length(trim(:value)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length(trim(:label)) BETWEEN 1 AND 60 AND :subject_type IN ('person','team','venue','club') AND :kind IN ('phone','email','postal','other') AND ((:subject_type='club' AND :subject_id=:org_id) OR (:subject_type='venue' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM venues v WHERE v.id=:subject_id AND v.org_id=:org_id)) OR (:subject_type='team' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams t WHERE t.id=:subject_id AND t.org_id=:org_id AND t.is_external=0)) OR (:subject_type='person' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships m WHERE m.org_id=:org_id AND m.user_id=:subject_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM roster_players rp JOIN fixtures f ON f.id=rp.fixture_id WHERE rp.id=:subject_id AND f.org_id=:org_id)))) ON CONFLICT(org_id,subject_type,subject_id,kind,label) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value, updated_at=excluded.updated_at

tools.name: delete_contact_detail
tools.description: Remove a structured contact detail; visible only to club managers, convenors and admins
tools.sql: DELETE FROM contact_details WHERE id=:id AND org_id=:org_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=contact_details.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager'))

tools.name: list_contact_details
tools.description: List structured contact details for a club, optionally for one subject; returns values, so only club managers, convenors and admins may call it
tools.sql: SELECT c.id,c.subject_type,c.subject_id,c.label,c.kind,c.value,c.updated_at FROM contact_details c WHERE c.org_id=:org_id AND (:subject_type IS NULL OR c.subject_type=:subject_type) AND (:subject_id IS NULL OR c.subject_id=:subject_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=c.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) ORDER BY c.subject_type, c.label, c.id LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

tools.name: list_contact_note_review
tools.description: List venue notes and match notices that look like contact details and are therefore withheld from player views; returns record ids and fields only, never the text
tools.sql: SELECT 'venue' AS subject_type, v.id AS subject_id, 'notes' AS field FROM venues v WHERE v.org_id=:org_id AND (v.notes GLOB '*@*' OR v.notes GLOB '*[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]*') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=v.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) UNION SELECT 'fixture', f.id, 'match_notice' FROM fixtures f WHERE f.org_id=:org_id AND (f.match_notice GLOB '*@*' OR f.match_notice GLOB '*[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]*') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm WHERE cm.org_id=f.org_id AND cm.user_id=:__user_id AND cm.is_active=1 AND cm.role IN ('admin','convenor','manager')) ORDER BY subject_type, subject_id LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset
